preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100000 for N, K, A in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of days N is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= K <= 100000 for N, K, A in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of places K is between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(A_i in range(-1, K+1) for A_i in A) for N, K, A in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each element A_i in the sequence A is either -1 or between 1 and K.

preconditions.expression: all(all(A[i] != A[i+1] for i in range(N-1) if A[i] != -1 and A[i+1] != -1) for N, K, A in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, if A_i and A_{i+1} are both not -1, then A_i is not equal to A_{i+1}.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, K, A in test_cases) <= 1000000
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 1000000.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(0, len(stdout), 2))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout[i+1].split()) == N for i, (N, K, A) in enumerate(test_cases) if stdout[i] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: For each test case where the output is 'YES', the second line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(A_i) in range(1, K+1) for A_i in stdout[i+1].split()) for i, (N, K, A) in enumerate(test_cases) if stdout[i] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: For each test case where the output is 'YES', each element in the second line is between 1 and K.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(stdout[i+1].split()[j]) != int(stdout[i+1].split()[j+1]) for j in range(N-1)) for i, (N, K, A) in enumerate(test_cases) if stdout[i] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: For each test case where the output is 'YES', no two consecutive elements in the second line are the same.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == 'YES' if all(A_i == -1 or (A_i != -1 and (j == 0 or int(stdout[i+1].split()[j-1]) != A_i)) for j, A_i in enumerate(A)) else stdout[i] == 'NO' for i, (N, K, A) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if the plan can be completed according to the rules, otherwise 'NO'.
